ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to make other source detail mandatory when leadsource is other
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Lead', ISBLANK(Other_Source_Detail__c), NOT(ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c)), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), Text(Lead_Originator__c) = 'MLCRM', TEXT(LeadSource) = 'Other' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Other source detail is mandatory when LeadSource is other
